title: Baby Shower Planning Checklist for Memphis Hosts | Porch & Party
h1: Baby shower planning checklist for Memphis hosts
description: A baby shower planning checklist with a working timeline for Memphis hosts: what to lock first, and where decor and grazing setup fit in.
intro: Most baby shower checklists are lists of things to buy. The order matters more than the list: two or three decisions gate everything else, and hosts who make them out of order end up rebooking around a venue or a date that was never confirmed. This checklist is ordered by what blocks what.
quickAnswer: Work the checklist in this order: confirm the guest of honour’s date window and guest count first, then the venue, then the date, then invitations, then food, then decor and setup. Decor comes late deliberately — styling decisions depend on the space and the guest count, and locking them earlier is what forces the expensive reversals.
forWho: Memphis-area hosts planning a baby shower for the first time, or anyone who wants the ordering right before spending on anything.

definition.term: Why the order of a shower checklist matters more than the list
definition.text: Every item on a shower checklist depends on something above it. Guest count decides venue; venue decides layout; layout decides what decor and food service actually fit. Buying decor before the venue is confirmed is the most common and most expensive mistake, because a backdrop bought for a living room rarely suits a rented room, and vice versa.

includes: A working order that puts the blocking decisions first
A timeline hosts can start from, adjustable to how much notice you have
The point in the sequence where decor and grazing setup should be booked
What to have settled before requesting a decor quote

protocol.title: The baby shower planning checklist, in order

steps.step: Confirm the date window with the guest of honour.
steps.detail: Showers usually land in the later stages of pregnancy but comfortably before the due date. Nothing else can be booked until this window is agreed, so this is step one and not a formality.

steps.step: Settle the guest list and get a real count.
steps.detail: The count decides the venue, the food quantity, and the seating. An approximate count is enough to start, but a firm one is needed before anything is paid for.
A home, a hotel or venue room, or a private space at a restaurant. Confirm it in writing before moving on — this is the item that most often changes and invalidates the steps after it.
Once the venue is confirmed, fix the date. Weekend daytime slots go first, so treat the venue and the date as one decision where you can.
Aim to give guests several weeks. Send earlier if the shower is on a holiday weekend or if guests are travelling into Memphis for it.
Do this after the venue, not before. A palette chosen against a room you have seen holds up; one chosen in the abstract usually needs redoing.

steps.step: Plan the food and the drinks.
steps.detail: Decide the format first — seated meal, light bites, or a grazing table — because format decides quantity, service, and how much table space the room has to give up.

This is the right point, with the venue, count, and palette settled. Porch & Party celebration setups start at $300+ and grazing table styling starts at $250+; both are quoted on the space and the scope, so having those three answers ready makes the quote fast and accurate.

steps.step: Plan the games, activities, and favours.
steps.detail: Keep them to what the room and the timeline allow. A crowded activity list is the thing hosts most often cut on the day.
Re-confirm the venue, the final head count, the food order, and the setup access window. The access window is the detail most often left vague and most likely to cause trouble.
Work backwards from the guest arrival time: setup access, decor install, food placement, then guests. Give the install more room than you think it needs.

protocol.note: If you have less notice than this sequence assumes, keep the order and compress the gaps. Reordering it is what causes the rework.

practical: The step hosts most often get wrong is the eighth one, and they get it wrong by doing it third. Decor booked before the venue is confirmed has to be reworked when the room turns out to be a different shape, a different colour, or available an hour later than expected. Booking it after the venue, the count, and the palette are settled is the difference between one quote and three.
authority: This page exists because baby shower checklists are published everywhere as flat lists of tasks, which is the least useful form for the person actually doing it. Sequencing is the part that has consequences, so this checklist is ordered by dependency and says where the decor decision genuinely belongs.

title: Grazing Table vs Charcuterie Board: What Is the Difference? | Porch & Party
h1: Grazing table vs charcuterie board: what is the difference?
description: The difference between a grazing table and a charcuterie board, in scale, contents, setup and cost basis, and how to decide which one an event needs.
intro: The two words get used interchangeably, and they describe different things. A charcuterie board is a serving board. A grazing table is a styled spread that takes over a table, and the difference changes who builds it, how many people it serves, and what you are actually paying for.
quickAnswer: A charcuterie board is a single board of cured meats, cheeses and accompaniments that a few people share. A grazing table is a whole table styled with food laid directly across it, built on site to feed and anchor a larger gathering. Choose a board for a small group; choose a grazing table when the food is also part of the room's decor.
forWho: Hosts planning a shower, birthday, corporate gathering or small event in the Memphis area who are deciding between a board and a full grazing table.

definition.text: A grazing table is a food display that covers a table surface rather than a board, laid out and styled on site so guests serve themselves over the course of an event. Because it is built in place and sized to the table and the guest count, the setup and styling are as much a part of it as the food.

title: Graduation Party Decorations at Home: A Memphis Host's Guide | Porch & Party
h1: Graduation party decorations at home: a Memphis host's guide
description: How to decorate a graduation party at home, in the order that works: the entry, the photo spot, the display table and the food table, with what to style first.
intro: A graduation party at home is decorated for guests who arrive in waves over an afternoon, walk through the front door, find the graduate, take a photo and eat. The decor that matters follows that path. Everything else is optional.
quickAnswer: Decorate a home graduation party along the route guests take: style the front porch or entry in the school colours, build one photo backdrop, set up a display table for the graduate's photos and memorabilia, and style the food table. Put the budget into the entry and the photo spot, because those are what guests see and what the photos keep.
forWho: Families hosting a high school or college graduation party at home or in a backyard in the Memphis area.

definition.term: Why home graduation decor follows the guest route
definition.text: Graduation parties are usually open-house in format: guests arrive and leave over several hours rather than all at once. Decor placed along the path every guest walks, from the porch to the photo spot to the food, is seen by everyone; decor spread thinly around the house is seen by few and photographed by nobody.

includes: The four places a home graduation party should be decorated, in order

protocol.title: Decorating a graduation party at home, in order

steps.step: Fix the format and the guest route.
steps.detail: Decide whether guests will be inside, in the backyard, or both, and walk the route they will take from the street. Every decor decision below hangs off that route.

steps.step: Style the front porch or entry.
steps.detail: It is the first thing every guest sees and the place people photograph arriving. School colours on the door, planters and entry are the highest-value decor at a home party. Porch & Party porch styling starts at $350+.
One strong backdrop, such as a balloon installation or styled wall with the graduate's name and year, beats several small ones. Put it where the light is good and there is room for a group.
Photos, the cap and gown, awards and school memorabilia. Keep it near the photo spot so the two read as one moment.
Open-house parties suit food guests help themselves to over hours. A styled grazing table doubles as decor; Porch & Party grazing styling starts at $250+, food not included by default.

steps.step: Plan setup around the start time.
steps.detail: Book installation for the morning of or the day before, depending on whether the decor is inside or outdoors in the heat. Outdoor balloon work goes up as close to the start as possible.

protocol.note: If the budget only stretches to one styled element, make it the entry or the photo backdrop, not the interior.

practical: The practical mistake is spreading decor evenly through the house. At an open-house party most guests see the porch, the photo spot and the food table and little else. Concentrating the decor in those three places makes a modest budget look like a full setup in every photo taken that day.
